title: Powers of Alexander Duals of Stanley-Reisner Ideals of Chessboard Complexes
summary: Let $Δ_{m,n}$ be the chessboard complex, and let $J_{m,n}$ be the Stanley-Reisner ideal of its Alexander dual. We study the symbolic and ordinary powers of $J_{m,n}$, focusing on their homological and algebraic invariants. First, we characterize when $J_{m,n}^{(q)}$ has linear quotients. For the ordinary powers, we give sufficient conditions on $m$ and $n$ for $J_{m,n}^q$ to have linear quotients.
